# Incident Triage Copilot

> An open-source incident response demo that turns sanitized alerts, logs, metrics, deployment notes, and service context into a structured triage brief.

Incident Triage Copilot returns severity, impacted service, a root-cause hypothesis, immediate next actions, and a confidence score. It uses a typed Next.js and FastAPI interface, supports deterministic heuristic triage, and can optionally use a configured LLM provider with heuristic fallback.

Important: This is a public demo. Use sample or sanitized data only. Do not submit secrets, personal data, or confidential incident details.

## Links

- [Live application](https://incidentcopilottriage.com/): Interactive public demo.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Jakey794/incident-triage-copilot): Architecture, setup, tests, and implementation.
- [License](https://github.com/Jakey794/incident-triage-copilot/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT License.

## Technology

- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: FastAPI, Python, Pydantic
- Deployment: Vercel and Google Cloud Run
